concise_summary: PKD develops an eschatological theology where Christ-as-Valis reassembles divinity across 2000 years through genetic carriers of divine DNA packets, culminating in the 1960s. He reinterprets his 2-74/3-74 visions as precisely engineered interventions (the Xerox missive, the Golden Fish, the pharmacy girl's sign, the game hen wrapper) that used 'pretextual cause' to trigger anamnesis and awaken GABA-blocked neural circuits. He proposes that dissociated consciousness—holding Pigspurt and Christian interpretations simultaneously—represents an evolutionary leap to 'doublethink,' a capacity to maintain mutually exclusive truths, positioning himself as a partisan receiving truth-explosives from Valis to liberate consciousness from the Black Iron Prison.
key_claims: The Gospel as Incomplete: The 1st Century account ends in failure/death; the 'full story' is the gradual reassembly of the King (Ho Kyrios) over 2000 years through the Reformation, Enlightenment, and 1960s.
Predestination vs. Autochthons: Salvation is not by faith or deeds but by being a genetic carrier of the 'DNA packet.' Valis (the narrow door) locates these carriers.

Pretextual Synchronization: Valis orchestrated the sequence (Tears publication, pentathol, pharmacy girl's fish sign) to trigger anamnesis just in time for the Xerox missive. It uses 'pretextual cause' (the fish) to mask the internal firing of info.
The Instruction Point: Like written instructions appearing on a game hen's wrapper only when it's ready to be used, the 3-74 info was released only when the 'goal point' of use was reached.
Partisans Behind Enemy Lines: PKD is a partisan (agent) in the BIP, receiving 'explosives' (truth) and 'money' (intelligence) from 'outside' (the skies/Valis) to blow up fortifications.

Doublethink as Evolutionary Advance: The dissociated self (Thomas/Pigspurt vs. Phil) represents a quantum leap in cognition—capacity to hold two mutually exclusive propositions simultaneously, transcending bourgeois logic.

Doublethink: The ability to hold two exclusive versions of reality (Pigspurt vs. Xtian) simultaneously as advanced dialectical cognition.
DNA Phylogenic Memory Packets: Genetic carriers of divine consciousness designed to awaken at appointed moments.
Pretextual Cause: Valis's method of arranging synchronistic events to mask the actual delivery of information.
Anamnesis: Involuntary recovery of suppressed or engrammed memories, triggered by external symbols (the Golden Fish).
The Plasmate: Distributed consciousness network linking Valis's scattered DNA carriers like a distributed brain communicating via constant message traffic.
The Narrow Door: Christ/Valis as the sole gatekeeper who identifies and chooses the elect genetic carriers.
Disinhibition: Chemical and psychological breakdown of dissociative barriers, allowing hidden selves to become conscious.
The Instruction Point: The moment when written purpose-instructions emerge, signifying an entity or system has reached its designed goal-stage.
